name: Honey Bun
source:
When a monster's diet consists of sexually charged affection (with a side of blood), you can only expect an underfed creature's reasoning to get a little... messy.

Follow Mettyse, a vampirish incubus (incupire), as he huffs, puffs and fails to communicate his growing needs until it's hard for his partner, Blue, not to notice.

[from [url=https://lovely-knives.itch.io/honeybun]itch.io[/url]]
